name: Prediction block shows probability bars with percentages
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink, the prediction block shows probability bars or percentages for the home, draw, and away outcomes.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Verify the prediction block renders probability bars or labeled percentages for the home, draw, and away outcomes, each showing a real value rather than an empty or zero-width bar
